headline: Kroger Pledges to Cut Grocery Prices by $5 Billion by 2029
summary: Grocery giant Kroger announced plans to cut grocery prices by $5 billion by 2029 as its new CEO aims to reduce costs for shoppers.
why: Major retail pricing strategies affect profit margins, competitive positioning within the consumer staples sector, and broader retail inflation trends.

impacts.name: Kroger
impacts.why: Aggressive retail pricing strategies affect profit margins while altering competitive positioning and retail inflation trends.
